Reward: 1,000 USDC
Deadline: 2026-07-10T22:59:59.999Z
Sponsor: MultiHopper

Build or configure an automated workflow that attempts a MultiHopper transfer
using the approved test environment and credentials supplied for the bounty.
Submit every valid issue with evidence, reproducible steps and a proposed fix.
